resolutions.phrase: The eighteen-month retention for Quillmoor field recordings, set on the 1 October planning call, is replaced by twelve months.

referents.why: Replaces the eighteen-month raw field recording retention period with twelve months.
Anchors on the 1 October planning call where the prior policy was established.

resolutions.why: Explicitly names and supersedes the eighteen-month Quillmoor field recording retention policy agreed upon in the 1 October planning call.
